remarks: Welcome to 12 Glenville Street, Unit 211, a sophisticated, turnkey three-level townhome located in the center of the hamlet of Glenville in the Town of Greenwich. Set within the popular Mill neighborhood, River Run, this 2,160 square foot residence offers a primary en-suite bedroom, a guest bedroom, 3.5 bathrooms, an office, a full basement with walkout sitting area, and one detached garage. Enjoy modern amenities like an updated kitchen, cherry hardwood floors, updated bathrooms, and a new water heater. The entire unit was recently re-painted. The building exterior was re-painted one year ago and the roof was redone three years ago.   Apart from the natural light, the waterfall and stream views from the balcony off the living room enhance the natural park-like setting. Offering a backdrop during all four seasons, the waterfall in front of the historic brick 1881 Building offers tranquility and charm.  Don't miss the rare opportunity to own one of the sought-after townhomes in River Run, offering proximity to Glenville's expanding downtown, the Merritt Parkway and nearby Greenwich Avenue. With ease, you have access to destination dining, shops, schools, highways, and other neighborhood amenities.
